_comment: Single source of truth for the public page set. `pages` feeds scripts/build-pages.mjs (shared chrome), scripts/gen-sitemap.mjs and the search index. `redirects` are the retired pages (owner decision #81, 2026-11-10): scripts/build-content.mjs writes each one as a tiny stub that sends the visitor to the homepage, and no builder gives them chrome, schema or a sitemap row. Adding a page means adding a row.
